candidateInput.sourceReturnDefinition: Stocks: existing replay split-continuous, partial-distribution accumulated index; not complete shareholder total return. ETF: existing corrected/reconciled gross distribution index. Raw KRX volume independently required at entry/exit and each valuation session. No fill, no simulated liquidation of missing names. All daily statistics use contiguous nonoverlapping paths, never stitched valid blocks.

sourceCostDefinition.note: KOSPI combined transaction/rural tax; exact 2019-06-03 reduction from 30 to 25bp. 2025 15bp, 2026 20bp per existing repository dated schedule, not independently legal-certified; doubled all-in cost sensitivity. ETF domestic equity tax=0; same commission/spread as stocks, intentionally conservative. Every candidate H-block liquidates and re-enters, even same names; passive ETF reference buys once and exits once per analysis window. Gross distributions before investor dividend tax; not payment-date executable wealth.

limitations: Stock partial distributions versus gross ETF distributions; not symmetric complete total return.
Ex-post continuing sample has survivorship bias; no live recommendation.
Reconstructed industry and historical input revision availability not fully certified PIT.
No unresolved payoff assumed. Strict broken paths have no full-period Sharpe/CAGR.
No training or tuning; chronological partitions are exposed development history.
Standalone blocks after an unresolved NAV are diagnostics, not a financed investment path.
